subject.title: perf(ci): recalibrate compact shard hints from 7-run loaded-fleet means

question: After the exact-head compact shard jobs complete, should the measured timing output be accepted as sufficient evidence that the 235-second cap preserves job count while improving balance?
rationale: The patch intentionally tunes operational CI scheduling from fleet measurements; whether the new measurement set is representative enough to change the production CI plan is a maintainer-owned operational judgment.

options.title: Accept completed timing evidence
options.body: Merge after the completed exact-head large and small compact shards support the claimed balance and no new queue or timeout regression is visible.

options.title: Recalibrate from a broader sample
options.body: Keep the existing planner values and request another measurement window if the completed run materially disagrees with the seven-run model.

recommendation.title: Accept completed timing evidence
recommendation.body: Merge after the completed exact-head large and small compact shards support the claimed balance and no new queue or timeout regression is visible.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest merged-history connection to the preceding timing-profile change and supplied the calibration methodology.
